en.html:
Kageaki"A child died just now, over there."
Kageaki"Do you remember him? The boy at that cafe..."
Kageaki"The one you told about justice."
Kageaki"One stone in his hand, he challenged the Occupation troops who had killed his parents. Braver than anyone in this world. Not even knowing what courage meant."
Kageaki"And... as one would expect, he died."
Ichijou"................................"
Kageaki"Ichijou. Once more I will say it. The last time."
Kageaki"I will not stop you fighting for the justice you believe in. But stop decorating・・ that fight with the word 'justice'."
Kageaki"So its ugly truth is not hidden. So that fight does not bring on the next fight."

Not even knowing what courage meant."

en.html:
Ichijou"What you say is right."
Ichijou"Fighting is just ugly killing on both sides. Nothing you can call justice."
Ichijou"Still insisting it's justice, taking other people with you and fighting on... that must be the worst evil of all. Unforgivable. Even so・・・・—"
Kageaki"............"
Ichijou"Ichijou AyaneI will raise justice and fight! Under that word, I will strike down evil!"
Ichijou"And I believe that at the end of it, there is a righteous world without fighting."
